name: S3 · Club event: team converges fast, one member has a private budget concern. Tests silence on convergence, anonymous concern, revision.

steps.title: T1 · Sara's private worry. Expected: private reply only.
steps.text: Our budget is only about 100 dollars and last year's picnic cost 200. I don't want to be the one who brings it up though.

steps.title: Team converges quickly. Expected: NO check on 'I liked the picnic too' or 'Same'.
steps.text: Any ideas for the end-of-semester event?
A picnic by the river like last year?
I liked the picnic too, let's not overthink it.

steps.title: Silence while converging. Expected: moderator stays quiet (no angle).
T3 · Decision. Expected: check opens. Sara pins down her concern and raises it anonymously.
steps.text: OK, picnic it is. Let's do it on Saturday.
Something about this bothers me but everyone already agrees.
It's the money. We only have 100 dollars and the picnic cost 200 last time.

steps.title: Revised decision. Expected: Agreed 4/4 and the concern is reflected.
steps.text: Good point on the budget. Let's do next Saturday, potluck style, and keep it under 100 dollars.
